slices.focus: Ayaka adopts mint herbal tea as a late-paperwork ritual after a restorative evening at friend Nozomi's apartment, replacing vending-machine coffee.
slices.summary: A tense week leads Ayaka to Nozomi's apartment, where mint tea helps her decompress. She starts keeping a sleeve in her locker for paperwork-heavy nights, finding it steadies her mood without coffee's jittery crash. The tea becomes a situational cue for focused desk work, kept separate from home to preserve the association.
open_loops: Ritual may lose effectiveness if overused or migrated home
Tea quality vs. budget trade-off needs monitoring
Pattern of replacing vending coffee needs to stay sustainable
decisions: Ayaka started keeping mint herbal tea in her locker for late paperwork shifts instead of relying on vending-machine coff
